scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.python-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');function scan(dir){fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(f=>{if(f.name==='node_modules'||f.name==='.git')return;const p=dir+'/'+f.name;if(f.isDirectory())scan(p);else if(f.name.endsWith('.py')){console.error('Python file detected:',p);process.exit(1);}})};scan('.');console.log('Zero Python Check: PASSED! 100% Pure JavaScript/Node.js/React.');"
